name: The Executive Centre Meguro Arco Tower
card: A 7th floor finished in wood, overlooking the cherry trees of the Meguro River
title: The Executive Centre Meguro Arco Tower — a 7th floor overlooking the Meguro River, with wood finishes and a lounge
lead: The Executive Centre has a centre on the 7th floor of Arco Tower in Meguro, about 31,645 sq ft in size. The website describes views over the Meguro River, lined with more than 800 cherry trees, and wood finishes that reflect the surrounding nature. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: The Executive Centre Meguro Arco Tower
About 31,645 sq ft (per the official site)
Private offices / coworking (hot desks, dedicated desks) / 5 meeting rooms / event space / café
concept: An interior that reflects the Meguro River's greenery
According to the website, the centre's design mirrors its natural surroundings and pays respect to a redevelopment that values the local environment.
Its features are wood finishes inspired by the environment, vintage furniture by Timothy Oulton and a large lounge looking out over the city. The Meguro River flows outside the windows.
steps: A lounge looking out over the city
The shared space the website calls “a large lounge overlooking the city”, and reception.
The lounge is also used as an event space.
Coworking seats and private offices priced on request, with height-adjustable desks.
Hot desks and dedicated desks start at ¥54,000 a month; day passes from ¥5,000 a day.
Five meeting rooms and the Meguro River
There are five meeting rooms, including a boardroom suited to board meetings.
The windows look out on the Meguro River and the city.

word.title: What is a boardroom?
body: A meeting room around a large table, used for board meetings and the like.
Among the five meeting rooms at the Meguro Arco Tower centre is a boardroom.

credits: © The Executive Centre (official website “Meguro Arco Tower”)
The Executive Centre official website: “Meguro Arco Tower”

name: JustCo Shibuya Hikarie
card: The 33rd floor above Shibuya Station — Mt Fuji on clear days
title: JustCo Shibuya Hikarie — coworking and private offices on the 33rd floor of Hikarie, directly connected to Shibuya Station
lead: JustCo Shibuya Hikarie is on the 33rd floor of Shibuya Hikarie, a complex directly connected to Shibuya Station. According to the website, the offices look out over Shibuya, Shinjuku, Shinagawa and Roppongi, the greenery of Yoyogi Park and Meiji Jingu, and on clear days all the way to Mt Fuji. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Directly connected to Shibuya Sta. (JR East, Tokyo Metro, Tokyu, Keio)
Private offices (1 to 50+ people) / coworking / meeting rooms / event space / virtual office
concept: Tokyo from the 33rd floor
The website presents the centre as a premium rental office on the 33rd floor of Shibuya Hikarie, directly connected to Shibuya Station.
From the windows: the cityscapes of Shibuya, Shinjuku, Shinagawa and Roppongi, the greenery of Yoyogi Park and Meiji Jingu — and on clear days, Mt Fuji.
steps: A shared space on the 33rd floor
The main lounge is where members gather, with a well-stocked pantry and a reading area.
Resident community staff support the centre.
From a single seat to a team room
Coworking hot desks, and private offices ranging from small rooms for 1–3 to large ones for 50 or more.
Phone booths, lockers and printers are available.
Meeting rooms are equipped with online meeting systems.
There is also an event space for internal and external events.

word.title: What is a phone booth?
body: A small private booth you enter alone for calls and online meetings.
Common in coworking spaces as a place where people working in an open lounge can talk without worrying about others — JustCo Shibuya Hikarie has them too.

name: JustCo Shinjuku Miraina Tower
card: 18th floor above NEWoMan, connected to the Miraina Tower gate
title: JustCo Shinjuku Miraina Tower — coworking on the 18th floor of JR Shinjuku Miraina Tower, directly connected to Shinjuku Station
lead: JustCo Shinjuku Miraina Tower is on the 18th floor of JR Shinjuku Miraina Tower, directly connected to the Miraina Tower gate of Shinjuku Station. The building houses NEWoMan Shinjuku and adjoins Takashimaya Times Square, and an underground passage links it to Shinjuku-sanchome Station. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Directly connected to Shinjuku Sta. (Miraina Tower gate); underground link to Shinjuku-sanchome Sta.
Private offices (1 to 50+ people) / coworking / meeting rooms / event space / virtual office
concept: A workplace above the station
The website presents the centre as an exceptionally convenient location on the 18th floor of JR Shinjuku Miraina Tower, directly connected to Shinjuku Station.

The building contains NEWoMan Shinjuku for shopping and dining, and an underground passage leads to Shinjuku-sanchome Station on the Tokyo Metro Marunouchi and Fukutoshin lines and the Toei Shinjuku Line.
steps: The main lounge where members gather, and a well-stocked pantry.
There is also a reading area for quiet reading and writing.
Coworking hot desks, and private offices for 1–3 up to 50 or more.
Phone booths, lockers and printers are available.
Meeting rooms are equipped with online meeting systems.
There is also an event space.

word.title: What is a pantry?
body: A small kitchen-like area for drinks and snacks.
JustCo Shinjuku Miraina Tower lists a well-stocked pantry among its facilities — also a place where members bump into each other.

credits: JustCo official website: “JustCo Shinjuku Miraina Tower”

name: JustCo GranTokyo South Tower
card: 11th floor connected to Tokyo Station, about 150 m from the Yaesu South exit
title: JustCo GranTokyo South Tower — premium coworking on the 11th floor, directly connected to Tokyo Station
lead: JustCo GranTokyo South Tower is on the 11th floor of GranTokyo South Tower, a commercial complex directly connected to Tokyo Station, about 150 m from the Yaesu South exit. The website highlights excellent access to the shinkansen, airport express trains, highway buses, JR and Tokyo Metro. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Directly connected to Tokyo Sta., about 150 m from the Yaesu South exit
Private offices (1 to 50+ people) / hot desks / dedicated desks / meeting rooms / event space / virtual office
concept: Right above the shinkansen station
The website presents the centre as premium coworking and shared offices in a commercial complex directly connected to Tokyo Station.

About 150 m from the Yaesu South exit, with connections to the shinkansen, airport express trains and highway buses, it can be the Tokyo front door for companies that travel a lot or have offices across Japan.
steps: The main lounge is where members gather, supported by resident community staff.
Phone booths, lockers and printers are available.
From small rooms to large ones
Choose a private office size: Small for 1–3, Mid-size for 4–49 and Enterprise for 50 or more.
Hot desks and dedicated desks are also available.
Meeting rooms are equipped with online meeting systems.
You can hold a meeting as soon as you arrive at Tokyo Station.

word.title: What is a dedicated desk?
body: A fixed seat in a coworking space that only you use. Unlike a hot desk, where you look for a free seat each time, you can leave your things there.
JustCo GranTokyo South Tower offers both hot desks and dedicated desks.

credits: JustCo official website: “JustCo GranTokyo South Tower”

name: THE HUB Akasaka
card: A four-storey building with a waiting area, meeting rooms and a tenants' lounge on the ground floor
title: THE HUB Akasaka — all-private offices at BIZMARKS Akasaka, with a waiting area and tenants' lounge on the ground floor
lead: THE HUB Akasaka is in BIZMARKS Akasaka, a four-storey building renovated in November 2020, four minutes from exit 5 of Akasaka Station on the Chiyoda Line and five from exit 11 of Tameike-Sanno Station. The ground floor has a waiting area for visitors, meeting rooms and a tenants-only lounge, and every office, for 1 to 5 people, is fully private. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Steel frame, 4 floors above ground / renovated November 2020
Private offices (1–5 people) / 2 meeting rooms (6 people) / booth-type private rooms / lounge / waiting space
Rental office from ¥78,430/month / all-site plan ¥16,500/month / single-site plan ¥9,900/month
concept: Shared spaces gathered on the ground floor
The website says: “The ground floor has a waiting area for visitors, meeting rooms and a tenants-only lounge. Offices for 1–5 people are all private, with furniture and internet included.”
Places to welcome and to gather are on the ground floor, with private rooms above — a whole four-storey building used as one site.
steps: A tenants' lounge and a waiting area for visitors
The ground floor has a tenants-only lounge and a waiting area for visitors, with free drinks.
Coworking costs ¥16,500 a month for the all-site plan, ¥9,900 for the single-site plan and ¥3,960 for the weekends-and-holidays plan.
There are two meeting rooms for six.
Booth-type private rooms are for calls and online meetings.
Offices for 1 to 5 people are all private, from ¥78,430 a month.
Move in with furniture and internet already in place.

word.title: What is renovation?
body: Updating an existing building's uses and performance. BIZMARKS Akasaka, home to THE HUB Akasaka, was renovated in November 2020.
Buildings brought back to life rather than rebuilt create places to work in the quieter parts of the city.

credits: THE HUB official website: “THE HUB Akasaka”

name: co-ba CHOFU
card: A “work-centred community” one minute from Chofu Station
title: co-ba CHOFU — a “work-centred community” with conversation-friendly tables, on the 2nd floor of the Kotobuki Building, one minute from Chofu Station
lead: co-ba CHOFU is on the 2nd floor of the Kotobuki Building, a one-minute walk from Chofu Station on the Keio Line. It opened in September 2014 and moved and renewed in March 2021. It calls itself “a work-centred community”, with work tables arranged to make conversation easy, valuing “room to not overwork” and connections between people. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Free-address work tables / meeting room (6) / phone booth / meeting space / event space
concept: A work-centred community
co-ba CHOFU calls itself “a work-centred community”. It opened in September 2014 and moved and renewed in March 2021.
Work tables are arranged so people can talk easily. It aims to be a place that achieves both “room to not overwork” and connections between people, the website says.
steps: Seating is free address, with work tables arranged for easy conversation.
Standard membership is ¥14,300 a month, usable every day from 7:00 to 23:59. There are also weekday-morning-only and evenings-and-weekends memberships.

word.title: What is drop-in?
body: Using a coworking space for the day without becoming a member. At co-ba CHOFU, drop-in is available 10:00–16:00 on weekdays for ¥110 per 15 minutes or ¥2,200 a day.
It is also a way to get a feel for the place and the people before joining.

name: co-ba Re-SOHKO Tamachi
card: An 8th floor in Shibaura's bay area, making the most of a raw, open-ceiling space
title: co-ba Re-SOHKO Tamachi — a bay-area skeleton space with a rooftop meeting area, on the 8th floor of Daisan Toun Building in Shibaura
lead: co-ba Re-SOHKO Tamachi is on the 8th floor of the Daisan Toun Building in Shibaura, a seven-minute walk from Tamachi Station on the JR Yamanote Line. It turns a bright bay-area skeleton space into customisable private rooms and an open coworking area, promising “an ideal work environment for startups and growing teams”. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Free address / private rooms / shared lounge / meeting rooms (large, small) / rooftop meeting space / phone booth
hero_cap: The workspace at co-ba Re-SOHKO Tamachi
concept: A skeleton space in the bay area
The website presents it as “an ideal work environment for startups and growing teams”.
A bright bay-area skeleton space is laid out as customisable private-room plans and an open coworking area. It is run by e-Sohko.com Co., Ltd.
steps: Free-address membership starts at ¥13,200 a month, and there is also a lounge membership.
Private rooms are plans that let you customise the skeleton space.
You can shape the room to your team's size and work.

word.title: What is a skeleton space?
body: A space with ceiling and wall finishes stripped away, leaving the building's structure exposed. co-ba Re-SOHKO Tamachi is built from such a space in the bay area.
Ceilings feel higher, and it is easy for users to make changes themselves.

name: co-coono KAMIKITAZAWA WORK LOUNGE
card: A work lounge attached to renovated rental housing, open from 6:00
title: co-coono KAMIKITAZAWA WORK LOUNGE — a work lounge attached to renovated rental housing, 6 minutes from Kamikitazawa Station
lead: co-coono KAMIKITAZAWA WORK LOUNGE is a workplace attached to “co-coono KAMIKITAZAWA”, renovated rental housing in Kamitakaido, Suginami-ku, a six-minute walk from Kamikitazawa Station on the Keio Line. Part of the co-ba network, it has a work lounge, meeting space, meeting room, phone booth and event space, open every day from 6:00 to 24:00. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: co-coono KAMIKITAZAWA WORK LOUNGE (co-ba co-coono Kamikitazawa)
Work lounge / meeting space / meeting room / phone booth / event space
Marui Home Service Co., Ltd. (Marui Group)
concept: A workplace attached to homes
The website describes it as “a workplace attached to the renovated rental housing ‘co-coono KAMIKITAZAWA’”.
It aims for “an environment where you can value time alone, take inspiration from meeting others and weave the future together”, the website says.
steps: The work lounge is open from 6:00 to 24:00.
Monthly membership is free address at ¥13,200 a month (including tax). Lockers and bicycle parking are available as options.
Places to talk and to meet
There is a meeting space and a meeting room for discussions.
A phone booth lets you take calls and online meetings separately.

word.title: What is an attached work lounge?
body: A shared workspace added to a building such as housing. co-coono KAMIKITAZAWA WORK LOUNGE is attached to renovated rental housing.
Having a place to work close to home makes switching between home and work easier.

credits: co-coono KAMIKITAZAWA WORK LOUNGE (Marui Home Service Co., Ltd.)
co-ba official website: “co-coono KAMIKITAZAWA WORK LOUNGE”

name: WeWork the ARGYLE aoyama
card: A new complex on the former Aoyama Bell Commons site, with shared areas in pale wood and oak
title: WeWork the ARGYLE aoyama — a site inside Kita-Aoyama's new landmark, 2 minutes from Gaiemmae Station
lead: WeWork the ARGYLE aoyama is in “the ARGYLE aoyama”, a mixed-use building on the site of Aoyama Bell Commons, long loved as a local landmark. It is a two-minute walk from Gaiemmae Station on the Tokyo Metro Ginza Line, and the building also has cafés, restaurants and a hotel. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Completed May 2020 / 20 floors above ground, 2 below
Ceiling height 2,800 mm / 9 meeting rooms / phone booths, parents' room, honesty market
concept: A bright space in pale wood and oak
The shared areas are bright and open, built around pale wood, with warm oak furniture, the website says. The interior is based on white.
The building also has shops that bring life to the street and an open event space. Companies of all sizes, from startups to large corporations, use the site.
steps: The shared areas are bright and open, with pale wood as the main material.
Oak furniture makes the space comfortable.
There are nine meeting rooms, plus phone booths, a parents' room and an honesty market.
Beyond head-office use, the website recommends it as a project room or a base for launching new businesses.
With cafés, restaurants and a hotel in the building, it suits work involving many visitors.

word.title: What is an honesty market?
body: An unstaffed shop at WeWork sites. “Honesty” means you settle the bill yourself.
You can get snacks and drinks without going far from your seat.

credits: WeWork official website: “WeWork the ARGYLE aoyama”
